title: Coordinate shared asynchronous resources safely
instruction: Harden AsyncResourceCoordinator while preserving its constructor and async acquire/release APIs. factory and closer are callables and limit is a positive exact integer limiting concurrently live distinct resources. Keys are non-empty strings. Concurrent acquire calls for one key must share one in-flight factory call and one resource while increasing a reference count. release decrements it and invokes closer exactly once at zero; unknown or over-release raises KeyError. Factory failure must reach all waiters, remove the failed entry, and release capacity so a later acquire can retry. Waiting caller cancellation must not cancel shared creation and must release only that caller's reference. Validate before state changes and remain race-safe. Add tests and no dependencies.

author_metadata.notes: Wave-4 lifecycle lineage using shared async creation, cancellation, capacity, and exact closure.
